description: This Java class provides centralized exception handling for a Spring Boot application. It maps specific exceptions to HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and error messages, facilitating API-friendly error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring REST controller advice that globally handles exceptions thrown in the application, converting them into JSON error responses.

methods.name: handleBadCreds
methods.description: Handles BadCredentialsException, returning a 401 Unauthorized response with an 'Invalid credentials' message.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from MethodArgumentNotValidException, returning a 400 Bad Request with details of field errors.

methods.name: handleGeneral
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error with the exception message.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates a standardized error response map with a timestamp and message.
